blocks.text: Selling a home in South Surrey, White Rock or Langley is not a sign on the lawn and a wait. Buyers look at a dozen homes online before they book one showing, so the listing has to look right on day one and stay in front of them until the right offer comes in. Every listing I take gets the same full package, built on a price set from recent nearby sales.
I have sold homes for 11+ years, with $500M+ in sales, and I am in the Top 1% of Fraser Valley REALTORS®. The plan below is what every seller gets.

v.t: Professional HDR photos of every room and the exterior.
Aerial photos that show the lot, its edges and the neighbourhood around it.
A cinematic video of your home, posted on my YouTube channel.
A short vertical version made for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.
Laser-measured, so room sizes in the listing are accurate.
A virtual walk-through buyers can take from their phone.
A printed feature booklet for showings and open houses.
5,000 postcards, plus Just Listed and Just Sold mailouts.
Paid ads on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok.
A listing boost through Royal LePage Sphere.
Your home on the MLS® and the sites that pull from it, plus a feature spot on jaredgibbons.ca.

blocks.text: Most homes need less work than owners expect. You do not need to renovate. We pick the few jobs that pay off, such as cleaning, small repairs and clearing clutter, and staging help comes with every listing. I line up the work through my trades network.
Listings typically go live about 5 days after you sign. If the home is already show-ready, it can be 2 to 3 days.

faq.q: What is included in your marketing plan?
faq.a: Every listing gets professional HDR photos, drone photos, a cinematic video, a short vertical video, a laser-measured floor plan, a 3D virtual tour, a printed booklet, staging help, paid ads on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, paid placement on REW.ca, a Royal LePage Sphere listing boost, 5,000 postcards and Just Listed and Just Sold mailouts.

faq.q: How long until my home is on the market?
faq.a: Typically about 5 days after you sign, or 2 to 3 days if the home is already ready to show.

faq.q: Where will my home be advertised?
faq.a: On the MLS® and the sites that pull from it, REW.ca, jaredgibbons.ca, my email list, YouTube, paid Facebook, Instagram and TikTok ads, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, Kijiji and local online news, plus mail and print.

faq.q: Do I need to renovate before I list?
faq.a: No. We choose the few jobs worth doing, usually cleaning, small repairs and clearing clutter, and staging help comes with every listing.

faq.q: How is the list price chosen?
faq.a: From what similar nearby homes sold for recently, what is listed now and what makes your home different. You get a price range with the reasons, free, through the home evaluation.

faq.q: Do I get feedback after showings?
faq.a: Yes. I send feedback after every showing, then review and negotiate each offer with you through to closing.
